Why Nemi

Most websites are silent. They show a logo and the opening hours, but they don’t tell you anything. We build websites that speak. With motion, with images and with a clear story.

Nemi is Serbian for “silent”. We chose the name because we do the opposite.

Process

From the first call to launch.

  1. 01

    Getting to know you

    One call, 30 minutes, free. You tell us about your business, we listen and ask the right questions.

    We’re a small café …Tell us more!
  2. 02

    Concept

    Moodboard, typefaces, colours and a first draft. You see the direction before a single line of code.

    Aa
  3. 03

    Design & build

    We build your website from scratch, without templates. A preview link shows you every step.

  4. 04

    Launch & care

    Domain, hosting, Google. We take everything live and stay with you afterwards.

FAQ

Good questions.

Your question isn’t here? Just write to us.

  • It depends on the scope. After the first call you get a clear, fixed-price quote with no hidden costs.

  • A one-page website is often live in two to three weeks. Bigger projects take longer, and we set the schedule together.

  • All of them. Café, law firm, garage or hotel, every industry has its own language, and we find the right one for you.

  • Mostly your knowledge of your business. Logo, texts and photos are welcome. Whatever is missing, we take care of.

  • Yes. We update opening hours, prices or new images quickly, on request as part of a monthly care plan.

  • Yes. We design for phones first and test on all common devices. Animations adapt and respect the reduced-motion setting.

Privacy

Controller

Nemi Studio is responsible for this website, see the legal notice for contact details.

Hosting

When you open the page, our hosting provider processes technically necessary data such as IP address, time and requested page to deliver the website and keep it secure (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Contact form

We only use your details to answer your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The form is delivered by a form service that processes the data on our behalf. We delete the data once it is no longer needed.

No cookies, no tracking

We use no cookies and no analytics or advertising services. Fonts and images are served from our own server.

Your rights

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection. You can lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority (dsb.gv.at).
